claims.name: CapdagCli.canAsk_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (t : CapdagCli.Terminal),
  t.canAsk = true ↔ t.reachable = true ∧ t.noInput = false ∧ t.json = false ∧ t.ci = false ∧ t.dumb = false

claims.name: CapdagCli.cli_exit_usage_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (v : CapdagCli.CliVerdict),
  v.exit = some 2 ↔ (∃ r, v = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.refused r) ∨ ∃ u, v = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is u ∧ u.exit = some 2

claims.name: CapdagCli.cli_fits
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (inv : CapdagCli.Invocation) (v : CapdagCli.Verdict),
  CapdagCli.cli w inv = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is v → CapdagCli.Fits w v

claims.name: CapdagCli.cli_refusal_says
claims.statement: ∀ (r : CapdagCli.CliRefusal), r.says ≠ ""

claims.name: CapdagCli.commandTable_named_once
claims.statement: (List.map (fun x => x.fst) CapdagCli.commandTable).Nodup ∧ CapdagCli.globalFlags.Nodup

claims.name: CapdagCli.decide_cases
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (s : CapdagCli.Stage) (c : CapdagCli.Choices) (then_ : CapdagCli.CliVerdict),
  c = CapdagCli.Choices.one ∧ CapdagCli.decide_ w s c then_ = then_ ∨
    (c = CapdagCli.Choices.many ∨ c = CapdagCli.Choices.free) ∧
        w.canAsk = true ∧ CapdagCli.decide_ w s c then_ = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is (CapdagCli.Verdict.asks s) ∨
      (c = CapdagCli.Choices.many ∨ c = CapdagCli.Choices.free) ∧
          w.canAsk = false ∧ CapdagCli.decide_ w s c then_ = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is (CapdagCli.Verdict.names s) ∨
        c = CapdagCli.Choices.taken ∧
            CapdagCli.decide_ w s c then_ = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is (CapdagCli.Verdict.extra s) ∨
          c = CapdagCli.Choices.none ∧
            CapdagCli.decide_ w s c then_ = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is (CapdagCli.Verdict.nothing s)

claims.name: CapdagCli.edit_needs_terminal
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (g : CapdagCli.Globals) (m : CapdagCli.Written) (ins : List CapdagCli.Positional),
  g.fabrics.eraseDups.length ≤ 1 →
    CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.command g (CapdagCli.Command.edit m ins)) =
      if w.fullScreen = true then CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is CapdagCli.Verdict.opens
      else CapdagCli.CliVerdict.refused CapdagCli.CliRefusal.needsTerminal

claims.name: CapdagCli.exit_usage_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (v : CapdagCli.Verdict),
  v.exit = some 2 ↔
    (∃ r, v = CapdagCli.Verdict.refused r) ∨
      (∃ s, v = CapdagCli.Verdict.names s) ∨ (∃ s, v = CapdagCli.Verdict.extra s) ∨ v = CapdagCli.Verdict.helpUsage

claims.name: CapdagCli.firstStop_first
claims.statement:
∀ (canAsk : Bool) (pre post : List CapdagCli.Entry) (e : CapdagCli.Entry),
  (∀ (x : CapdagCli.Entry), x ∈ pre → (CapdagCli.settle x.snd.fst canAsk x.snd.snd).ok = true) →
    (CapdagCli.settle e.snd.fst canAsk e.snd.snd).ok = false →
      CapdagCli.firstStop canAsk (pre ++ e :: post) =
        match CapdagCli.settle e.snd.fst canAsk e.snd.snd with
        | CapdagCli.Settled.ask => some (CapdagCli.Verdict.asks e.fst)
        | CapdagCli.Settled.name => some (CapdagCli.Verdict.names e.fst)
        | CapdagCli.Settled.extra => some (CapdagCli.Verdict.extra e.fst)
        | CapdagCli.Settled.nothing => some (CapdagCli.Verdict.nothing e.fst)
        | x => none

claims.name: CapdagCli.firstStop_none_canAsk
claims.statement: ∀ (a b : Bool) (l : List CapdagCli.Entry), CapdagCli.firstStop a l = none ↔ CapdagCli.firstStop b l = none

claims.name: CapdagCli.firstStop_none_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (canAsk : Bool) (l : List CapdagCli.Entry),
  CapdagCli.firstStop canAsk l = none ↔
    ∀ (e : CapdagCli.Entry), e ∈ l → (CapdagCli.settle e.snd.fst canAsk e.snd.snd).ok = true

claims.name: CapdagCli.firstStop_some
claims.statement:
∀ (canAsk : Bool) (l : List CapdagCli.Entry) (v : CapdagCli.Verdict),
  CapdagCli.firstStop canAsk l = some v →
    ∃ s,
      v = CapdagCli.Verdict.asks s ∧ canAsk = true ∨
        v = CapdagCli.Verdict.names s ∧ canAsk = false ∨ v = CapdagCli.Verdict.extra s ∨ v = CapdagCli.Verdict.nothing s

claims.name: CapdagCli.give_flags
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (a : Nat),
  (CapdagCli.give w l CapdagCli.Stage.stdinType a).hasFrom = true ∧
    (CapdagCli.give w l CapdagCli.Stage.target a).targets = 1

claims.name: CapdagCli.give_machine_written
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (a : Nat),
  (CapdagCli.give w l CapdagCli.Stage.machine a).machine.isSome = true

claims.name: CapdagCli.give_option_binds
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (j a : Nat),
  ∃ m, (CapdagCli.give w l (CapdagCli.Stage.option j) a).machine = some m ∧ j ∈ m.consts

claims.name: CapdagCli.help_command
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (words : List Nat),
  CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.helpCommand words) =
    if w.helpKnown words = true then CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is CapdagCli.Verdict.help
    else CapdagCli.CliVerdict.refused CapdagCli.CliRefusal.noSuchCommand

claims.name: CapdagCli.help_runs_nothing
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (t : CapdagCli.HelpTopic),
  CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.helpFlag t) = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is CapdagCli.Verdict.help ∨
    CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.helpFlag t) =
        CapdagCli.CliVerdict.refused (CapdagCli.CliRefusal.line CapdagCli.Refusal.noSuchMachine) ∨
      CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.helpFlag t) = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is CapdagCli.Verdict.unresolved

claims.name: CapdagCli.machineStages_rerun
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (t : CapdagCli.Terminal) (m : CapdagCli.Written) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (e : CapdagCli.Entry),
  e ∈
      CapdagCli.machineStages (w.at t)
        { base := m.base, inline := m.inline, consts := m.consts ++ CapdagCli.openOptions w m }
        { machine := some { base := m.base, inline := m.inline, consts := m.consts ++ CapdagCli.openOptions w m },
          inputs := l.inputs, named := l.named, targets := l.targets, hasFrom := l.hasFrom,
          hasSelector := l.hasSelector } →
    e ∈ CapdagCli.machineStages w m l

claims.name: CapdagCli.nothing_chosen_prints_nothing
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (m : CapdagCli.Written),
  l.machine = some m → CapdagCli.openOptions w m = [] → CapdagCli.printsRerun w l l = false

claims.name: CapdagCli.nothing_named_is_usage
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (g : CapdagCli.Group),
  CapdagCli.cli w CapdagCli.Invocation.bare = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is CapdagCli.Verdict.helpUsage ∧
    CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.group g) = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is CapdagCli.Verdict.helpUsage ∧
      (CapdagCli.cli w CapdagCli.Invocation.bare).exit = some 2 ∧
        (CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.group g)).exit = some 2

claims.name: CapdagCli.ofCandidates_none_taken
claims.statement:
∀ (all left : List Nat),
  (CapdagCli.Choices.ofCandidates all left = CapdagCli.Choices.none ↔ all = []) ∧
    (CapdagCli.Choices.ofCandidates all left = CapdagCli.Choices.taken ↔ all ≠ [] ∧ left = [])

claims.name: CapdagCli.ofCandidates_one_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (all left : List Nat), CapdagCli.Choices.ofCandidates all left = CapdagCli.Choices.one ↔ all ≠ [] ∧ left.length = 1

claims.name: CapdagCli.ofCount_one_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (n : Nat), CapdagCli.Choices.ofCount n = CapdagCli.Choices.one ↔ n = 1

claims.name: CapdagCli.ofLine_is
claims.statement: ∀ (u v : CapdagCli.Verdict), CapdagCli.ofLine u = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is v → u = v

claims.name: CapdagCli.offline_fetches_nothing
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (g : CapdagCli.Globals) (c : CapdagCli.Command),
  g.fabrics.eraseDups.length ≤ 1 →
    g.offline = true →
      c.fetches = true →
        CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.command g c) = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.refused CapdagCli.CliRefusal.offline

claims.name: CapdagCli.openOptions_closed
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (m : CapdagCli.Written),
  CapdagCli.openOptions w { base := m.base, inline := m.inline, consts := m.consts ++ CapdagCli.openOptions w m } = []

claims.name: CapdagCli.plan_cases
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.PlanLine),
  (∃ r, CapdagCli.planVerdict w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.refused r) ∨
    CapdagCli.planVerdict w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.answers ∨
      (∃ s, CapdagCli.planVerdict w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.asks s ∧ w.canAsk = true) ∨
        (∃ s, CapdagCli.planVerdict w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.names s ∧ w.canAsk = false) ∨
          (∃ s, CapdagCli.planVerdict w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.extra s) ∨
            ∃ s, CapdagCli.planVerdict w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.nothing s

claims.name: CapdagCli.plan_never_runs
claims.statement: ∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.PlanLine), CapdagCli.planVerdict w l ≠ CapdagCli.Verdict.runs

claims.name: CapdagCli.planned_no_live
claims.statement:
∀ (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  l.machine = none → CapdagCli.refusal l = none → ∀ (x : CapdagCli.Positional), x ∈ l.inputs → x.isLive = false

claims.name: CapdagCli.printsRerun_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (typed final : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  CapdagCli.printsRerun w typed final = true ↔ CapdagCli.rerun w final ≠ typed

claims.name: CapdagCli.readArgs_machine_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (separated : Bool) (a : CapdagCli.Arg) (rest : List CapdagCli.Arg),
  (CapdagCli.readArgs separated (a :: rest)).fst.isSome = (a.spelling.isMachine && !separated)

claims.name: CapdagCli.readArgs_rest_inputs
claims.statement:
∀ (separated : Bool) (a : CapdagCli.Arg) (rest : List CapdagCli.Arg),
  ∃ pre, (CapdagCli.readArgs separated (a :: rest)).snd = pre ++ List.map CapdagCli.Arg.input rest

claims.name: CapdagCli.readArgs_separated
claims.statement: ∀ (args : List CapdagCli.Arg), CapdagCli.readArgs true args = (none, List.map CapdagCli.Arg.input args)

claims.name: CapdagCli.refusal_none_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  CapdagCli.refusal l = none ↔
    (l.machine.isSome = true ∨ l.inputs ≠ [] ∨ l.named ≠ []) ∧
      (l.machine.isSome = true → l.targets = 0 ∧ l.hasFrom = false) ∧
        (l.hasFrom = true → l.stdinCount ≠ 0) ∧
          l.stdinCount ≤ 1 ∧
            (l.machine.isNone = true → l.named = [] ∧ l.lives.length = 0) ∧ (l.hasSelector = true → l.lives.length = 1)

claims.name: CapdagCli.refusal_says
claims.statement: ∀ (r : CapdagCli.Refusal), r.says ≠ ""

claims.name: CapdagCli.refusal_written
claims.statement:
∀ (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (m m' : CapdagCli.Written),
  l.machine = some m →
    CapdagCli.refusal
        { machine := some m', inputs := l.inputs, named := l.named, targets := l.targets, hasFrom := l.hasFrom,
          hasSelector := l.hasSelector } =
      CapdagCli.refusal l

claims.name: CapdagCli.rerun_asks_nothing
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (t : CapdagCli.Terminal),
  (l.machine = none → CapdagCli.PlansFrom w l) →
    CapdagCli.resolve w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs →
      CapdagCli.resolve (w.at t) (CapdagCli.rerun w l) = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs

claims.name: CapdagCli.rerun_rerun
claims.statement: ∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine), CapdagCli.rerun w (CapdagCli.rerun w l) = CapdagCli.rerun w l

claims.name: CapdagCli.rerun_runs_planned
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  l.machine = none →
    CapdagCli.PlansFrom w l →
      ∀ (t : CapdagCli.Terminal),
        CapdagCli.resolve w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs →
          CapdagCli.resolve (w.at t) (CapdagCli.rerun w l) = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs

claims.name: CapdagCli.rerun_runs_written
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (m : CapdagCli.Written),
  l.machine = some m →
    ∀ (t : CapdagCli.Terminal),
      CapdagCli.resolve w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs →
        CapdagCli.resolve (w.at t) (CapdagCli.rerun w l) = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs

claims.name: CapdagCli.rerun_written
claims.statement: ∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine), (CapdagCli.rerun w l).machine.isSome = true

claims.name: CapdagCli.resolve_asks_only_if
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (s : CapdagCli.Stage),
  CapdagCli.resolve w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.asks s → w.canAsk = true

claims.name: CapdagCli.resolve_cases
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  (∃ r, CapdagCli.resolve w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.refused r) ∨
    CapdagCli.resolve w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.unresolved ∨
      CapdagCli.resolve w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs ∨
        (∃ s, CapdagCli.resolve w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.asks s ∧ w.canAsk = true) ∨
          (∃ s, CapdagCli.resolve w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.names s ∧ w.canAsk = false) ∨
            (∃ s, CapdagCli.resolve w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.extra s) ∨
              ∃ s, CapdagCli.resolve w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.nothing s

claims.name: CapdagCli.resolve_names_only_if
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (s : CapdagCli.Stage),
  CapdagCli.resolve w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.names s → w.canAsk = false

claims.name: CapdagCli.resolve_not_opens
claims.statement: ∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine), CapdagCli.resolve w l ≠ CapdagCli.Verdict.opens

claims.name: CapdagCli.resolve_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (r : CapdagCli.Refusal),
  CapdagCli.refusal l = some r → CapdagCli.resolve w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.refused r

claims.name: CapdagCli.resolve_runs
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  CapdagCli.resolve w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs →
    CapdagCli.refusal l = none ∧
      CapdagCli.missingThing w l = none ∧
        CapdagCli.RunLine.resolves w l = true ∧
          ∀ (e : CapdagCli.Entry), e ∈ CapdagCli.stages w l → e.snd.fst = true ∨ e.snd.snd = CapdagCli.Choices.one

claims.name: CapdagCli.resolve_runs_any_terminal
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (t : CapdagCli.Terminal),
  CapdagCli.resolve w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs ↔ CapdagCli.resolve (w.at t) l = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs

claims.name: CapdagCli.resolve_runs_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  CapdagCli.resolve w l = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs ↔
    CapdagCli.refusal l = none ∧
      CapdagCli.missingThing w l = none ∧
        CapdagCli.RunLine.resolves w l = true ∧ CapdagCli.firstStop w.canAsk (CapdagCli.stages w l) = none

claims.name: CapdagCli.runs_only_run
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (inv : CapdagCli.Invocation),
  CapdagCli.cli w inv = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is CapdagCli.Verdict.runs →
    ∃ g l pf, inv = CapdagCli.Invocation.command g (CapdagCli.Command.run l pf)

claims.name: CapdagCli.settle_ambiguous
claims.statement:
∀ (canAsk : Bool) (c : CapdagCli.Choices),
  c = CapdagCli.Choices.many ∨ c = CapdagCli.Choices.free →
    CapdagCli.settle false canAsk c = if canAsk = true then CapdagCli.Settled.ask else CapdagCli.Settled.name

claims.name: CapdagCli.settle_ask_only_if
claims.statement: ∀ (said canAsk : Bool) (c : CapdagCli.Choices), CapdagCli.settle said canAsk c = CapdagCli.Settled.ask → canAsk = true

claims.name: CapdagCli.settle_name_only_if
claims.statement: ∀ (said canAsk : Bool) (c : CapdagCli.Choices), CapdagCli.settle said canAsk c = CapdagCli.Settled.name → canAsk = false

claims.name: CapdagCli.settle_none
claims.statement: ∀ (canAsk : Bool), CapdagCli.settle false canAsk CapdagCli.Choices.none = CapdagCli.Settled.nothing

claims.name: CapdagCli.settle_ok_canAsk
claims.statement: ∀ (said a b : Bool) (c : CapdagCli.Choices), (CapdagCli.settle said a c).ok = (CapdagCli.settle said b c).ok

claims.name: CapdagCli.settle_ok_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (said canAsk : Bool) (c : CapdagCli.Choices),
  (CapdagCli.settle said canAsk c).ok = true ↔ said = true ∨ c = CapdagCli.Choices.one

claims.name: CapdagCli.settle_said
claims.statement: ∀ (canAsk : Bool) (c : CapdagCli.Choices), CapdagCli.settle true canAsk c = CapdagCli.Settled.given

claims.name: CapdagCli.settle_taken
claims.statement: ∀ (canAsk : Bool), CapdagCli.settle false canAsk CapdagCli.Choices.taken = CapdagCli.Settled.extra

claims.name: CapdagCli.stdin_count_named
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (xs : List CapdagCli.Positional),
  (List.filter (fun x => x.snd == CapdagCli.Value.stdin)
        (List.filterMap (fun x => Option.map (fun x_1 => (w.plannedInput x, x_1)) x.value) xs)).length =
    (List.filter (fun x => x == CapdagCli.Positional.stdin) xs).length

claims.name: CapdagCli.two_fabrics_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (g : CapdagCli.Globals) (c : CapdagCli.Command),
  g.fabrics.eraseDups.length > 1 →
    CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.command g c) = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.refused CapdagCli.CliRefusal.twoFabrics

claims.name: CapdagCli.version_shown
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld),
  CapdagCli.cli w CapdagCli.Invocation.version = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is CapdagCli.Verdict.version

claims.name: CapdagCli.written_ignores_planning
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (m : CapdagCli.Written),
  l.machine = some m →
    ∀ (targets machines : CapdagCli.Choices) (planned : Nat → Nat) (plannedInput : CapdagCli.Positional → Nat),
      CapdagCli.resolve
          { terminal := w.terminal, fileThere := w.fileThere, machineFile := w.machineFile, resolves := w.resolves,
            targets := targets, machines := machines, planned := planned, plannedInput := plannedInput,
            inputs := w.inputs, fit := w.fit, options := w.options, optionChoices := w.optionChoices }
          l =
        CapdagCli.resolve w l
